summary: J.P. Morgan Real Estate Income Trust filed a routine Form 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing monthly common stock distributions declared September 30, 2026, for record holders of record that same date. Each class (I, D, T, E, Y) carries a $0.0438 gross per-share distribution; Class T nets $0.0358 and Class Y $0.0359 after stockholder servicing fees, while Class I, D and E have no fee. Class D servicing fee was waived for September 2026 and excluded in perpetuity. Payment occurs on or about October 5, 2026, in cash or via DRIP reinvestment. No shares of Class S or X are outstanding.
